info.title: BTC Futures Assistant Actions
info.description: Unified BTCUSDT market, context, lifecycle, deterministic calculation, and analytics-only GPT decision telemetry actions.

snapshotId.description: snapshotId from the live decision context used for this analysis. Validation rejects a superseded or mismatched market snapshot.

decisionId.description: Unique id for this exact GPT decision. Reuse only when retrying the identical record request.

snapshotId.description: snapshotId from the exact live Decision Context used for this decision.

marketGeneratedAt.description: marketGeneratedAt from the same live Decision Context used for this decision.

parentDecisionId.description: Known prior decision id when this is an explicit reanalysis; otherwise null.

triggerSummary.description: Short machine-useful trigger summary, not hidden chain-of-thought.

invalidationSummary.description: Short machine-useful invalidation summary, not hidden chain-of-thought.

snapshotId.description: Exact snapshotId from the current Decision Context.

get.summary: Get the latest validated BTCUSDT snapshot

post.summary: Validate an exact-size 1 to 150x isolated manual plan

409.description: Current snapshot cannot validate this plan

get.summary: Get the latest manual or paper lifecycle state

post.summary: Record the structured result of the current GPT trading decision for later evaluation
post.description: Analytics-only write. Records a decision made from a specific market snapshot. This endpoint cannot place, modify, or cancel exchange orders or change account state.

200.description: Idempotent retry of an already stored identical decision

401.description: Missing or invalid Action API key

409.description: Missing snapshot, metadata mismatch, or conflicting reuse of decisionId

get.summary: Get the compact, freshness-adjusted live decision context
get.description: Primary live GPT decision endpoint. Returns the latest BTC decision core plus objective ETH/SOL lead evidence, dynamic alt-market breadth, cross-market context, memory, reasoning policy, position-management context, evidence health, provenance, and latency telemetry. Auxiliary market evidence never overrides BTC decision gates.

404.description: No snapshot has been relayed yet

500.description: Decision context exceeded the action response budget

503.description: Stored snapshot or decision context is unavailable

post.summary: Validate a GPT-selected open-position adjustment without placing orders
post.description: Pure validation/calculation for PARTIAL_EXIT, EXIT, MOVE_STOP, or CHANGE_TP against the exact latest snapshot and current read-only/manual position. Never creates or changes an exchange order.
